subject: ela
skillName: Determine two or more main ideas
intro: Pick the main ideas or best summary.

items.prompt:
Read.

Exercise makes muscles stronger. It also keeps the heart healthy.

The two main ideas are:
A) muscles and heart
B) food and sleep
C) only muscles

A short retelling of the key ideas, without opinion, is a:
A) main idea
B) summary
C) title

Main ideas are supported by:
A) key details
B) the cover
C) the page number

steps: Details support ideas. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Recycling saves resources and reduces trash in landfills.

Which is a BEST summary?
A) Recycling saves resources and cuts landfill trash.
B) I love recycling.
C) Trash is heavy.
items.answer: A) Recycling saves resources and cuts landfill trash.

steps: Covers both ideas, no opinion. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Recycling saves resources and cuts landfill trash.

items.prompt:
A summary should NOT include:
A) the key ideas
B) your personal opinion
C) the topic

Read.

The rainforest holds many species and produces much of Earth's oxygen.

How many main ideas?
A) One
B) Two
C) Zero

steps: Species AND oxygen. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Volcanoes can destroy nearby land and homes. Yet over time, their ash and lava break down into rich soil that helps plants thrive.

The TWO main ideas are that volcanoes:
A) are only dangerous
B) can destroy but also create rich soil
C) are found underwater
items.answer: B) can destroy but also create rich soil

solution.answer: B) can destroy but also create rich soil

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST summary of a text about how sleep helps memory and healing?
A) Sleep is important because it helps the brain remember and the body heal.
B) Sleep is my favorite thing.
C) Beds are comfortable.
items.answer: A) Sleep is important because it helps the brain remember and the body heal.

steps: Both ideas, no opinion. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Sleep is important because it helps the brain remember and the body heal.
